description: This source file defines React components and utility functions related to list formatting buttons in a rich text editor interface. It includes logic for rendering list toggle buttons and checking list node types within the editor.

methods.name: isListType
methods.description: Checks if a given node type is either 'ordered-list' or 'unordered-list'.

methods.name: isListNode
methods.description: Type guard function that verifies if a Slate node is an Element with a type of 'ordered-list' or 'unordered-list'.

methods.name: ListButtons
methods.description: React component that renders toolbar buttons for toggling ordered and unordered lists based on editor state and props.
